We can use ls with path? The ls tool only lists current directory. We can use find? But we need to navigate. There's no tool to change directory. Maybe we can use pwd to see current. It can accept path. So we can call find with path="/tmp" and name=None. That will list all files and directories under /tmp recursively. But we want to list all files available there, including hidden. find will include hidden? It will list all items. So we can call find. But we need to show in terminal. We can just output the result. Let's call find.
